explanation: Searched Mathlib for `diagonalUnitsHom`, `diagonalSubgroup`, `DiagonalGroup` (no matches), and for all diagonal-related material in `Mathlib/Data/Matrix/Diagonal.lean`, `Mathlib/Data/Matrix/Basic.lean` (`diagonalRingHom`, `scalar`), `Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Pi/Units.lean` (`MulEquiv.piUnits`) and `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/GeneralLinearGroup/Defs.lean` (which has `scalar`, `map_scalar`, `kronecker`, but no diagonal subgroup/units map into `GL`). Mathlib has no monoid hom `(ι → Rˣ) →* GL ι R` given by diagonal matrices, so there is no declaration stating the entrywise value of such a map. The closest statement, `Matrix.diagonal_apply` (Mathlib/Data/Matrix/Diagonal.lean), is about `Matrix.diagonal`, not about `diagonalUnitsHom`; deriving this theorem from it requires `change`, i.e. definitional unfolding of the library's own `diagonalUnitsHom` (through `Units.map`, `diagonalRingHom`, `piUnits`, and the `GL` structure), so the substance here lies in the library's own definitions rather than in a Mathlib result.
